page.content:
Roddenberry's Federation, starship crews, and the optimism that kept getting remade.

How Star Trek connects

  • Artist: Gene Roddenberry — Gene Roddenberry created Star Trek.
  • Series: Star Trek: The Original Series — The Original Series is the first Star Trek weekly series.
  • Series: Star Trek: The Next Generation — The Next Generation is the 24th-century weekly series.
  • Series: Star Trek: Voyager — Voyager is the Delta Quadrant weekly series.
  • Work: Star Trek: First Contact — First Contact is the 1996 TNG feature film.

What is Star Trek?

Star Trek is Gene Roddenberry's science-fiction cycle of Starfleet crews, the United Federation of Planets, and first-contact ethics. It runs from The Original Series through The Next Generation, Voyager, the films — including First Contact — and later series that still argue with the Prime Directive.

Key threads lead to Gene Roddenberry, Star Trek: The Original Series, Star Trek: The Next Generation, Star Trek: Voyager and Star Trek: First Contact.
